rules.note: Database schema source changes can alter the documented database shape. Migration-only maintenance is covered by migration-chain validation and does not change the public schema reference.
Deployment capability changes must be reflected in the generated mode reference.
Worker dispatch and API transport changes affect the documented request flow.
Inspection API route changes affect the endpoint reference.
Request-shape validation changes can alter API contracts and role behavior.
Design-token source changes must keep the design-system guide accurate.
Documentation-reference checker changes must keep their user-facing instructions current.
Gate implementation and registration changes must keep the gate guide current.
Environment-reference generator changes must update its generated output and instructions.
Deployment-mode generator changes must update its generated output and instructions.
Schema-reference check changes must keep the generated-document gate instructions current.
